title: Diagonal Redstone Dust
description: Turns corner redstone dust into perfectly diagonal lines!
body:
# Diagonal Redstone Dust
This resource pack turns corner redstone dust into perfectly diagonal lines. It also comes with a more aesthetically pleasing solid line texture.

This was made for 1.20.4, but it should work for all versions.

![diagonal redstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29982154b0525be97487efb4beb7f08331bebdde_0.webp)

It's very simple and intuitive to use so you won't have any difficulties using the pack.

![with pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47c4e608fa57ae924b8f19aa7c9a204589d86c2d.png)
